_source.origin: InfiniteSkills 'all four link types' MS Project 2013 teaching/course working file.
_source.export_method: Extracted with MPXJ (https://www.mpxj.org/), not by running MS Project ourselves. Task graph, durations, calendar and the Start/Finish dates MS Project computed and saved are reproduced verbatim from that extraction.
_source.calendar: Standard: Mon-Fri, 08:00-12:00/13:00-17:00, zero calendar exceptions (no holidays). The engine schedules in whole working days, so the lunch break is not separately modeled (hours_per_day is reserved-but-inert, see Calendar docstring).
_source.notes: The source file's tasks 5-7 (and its Start-to-Finish relation on tasks 1-4) are out of scope here: #4322 uses those for the SF reference case, so this fixture holds only the 1/2/3/4 slice #4323 needs. Task 3's own FS predecessor (task 2) is incidental scaffolding giving task 3 real dates, not itself under test. What is under test: the zero-lag FF relation 2<-1 and the zero-lag SS relation 4<-3, both on a whole-day calendar (#4323). 2013-01-01 is a Tuesday. Verified: schedule() reproduces all four saved Start/Finish dates at day level.
